lines.text: Fools who loathed all food cried out, and the LORD sent a prophet to heal them.

wrong_details.wrong: sent a prophet to heal them
wrong_details.true: sent forth His word and healed them

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "sent bread from heaven" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "sent forth His word and healed them" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
